Maria Chen: Quick q — who is authorized to press the streaming kill switch for /v2/streaming? Need to lock down before tomorrow's deploy.

Jon Patel: Oncall (eng-sre rotation) + Eng Platform lead can. Are you planning a full disable or a canary bisection?

Maria Chen: Full emergency disable — token churn spiking, need immediate stop if it flares. Not a rollout.

SRE-Leah: Steps (short):
1) Announce to #incidents and page oncall.
2) Flip feature flag via ops-console or CLI: `/ops/ff flip streaming_kill_all --actor @SRE-Leah --reason "high token burn" --ttl 30m`
3) Validate: `ops/ff audit streaming_kill_all --since 1h` and check `telemetry/streaming/requests` and `cost/token_burn`
4) If >30m required, must escalate to Eng Director + Security.

Oncall-Alex: Confirmed. If I'm oncall when this happens I'm authorized to flip for up to 30m. Will notify infra-sre and product-manager.

DevEx Sam: Can we add the runbook link here so phone ops have it? https://internal.redwood/ops/ff-runbook :eyes:

SRE-Leah: Added to runbook. Also add a short postmortem template to the commit so we capture why and how it was flipped.

deploy-bot: Created incident INC-2024 and attached preflight checks. (auto)

ops-bot: Audit entry created for tentative flip by @Maria Chen (pending). Use `ops/audit view INC-2024` to follow.

Maria Chen: OK — assigning Oncall-Alex as primary flipper for the morning window (6am-12pm PT). Alex, please confirm you have MFA + admin key.

Oncall-Alex: Have MFA + admin key. Will add a comment to INC-2024 after flip and ping #product-outage.

Jon Patel: One more guardrail: allowlist the canary audience = internal-only IPs, and block external traffic for 10m after flip to ensure no resume.

SRE-Leah: Noted. I'll add a guard in the CLI: `--block-egress true` when flipping.

Maria Chen: Thanks all. Adding check: post-flip smoke tests (chat generation + embeddings quick run). If any regressions escalate immediately.

DevEx Sam: I'll update the quickcheck script to run after flip and post status to INC-2024.

Maria Chen: Great. If anyone else needs write access to flip in that window, comment here. Otherwise we'll roll with this plan. :thumbsup:
